title: Temple TX Home Prices Just Dropped 4.7%: Is Now the Time to Buy?
description:
Are you wondering if the Temple, Texas real estate market is crashing or if it's finally the right time to buy? Plenty of First time home buyers, and people relocating to Temple Tx ask me this! In this January 2026 Market Update, I pull the raw MLS numbers to show you exactly what is happening with home prices, inventory, and interest in Bell County.

Whether you are looking for new construction in Belton or resale homes in Temple, the market has shifted BIG TIME. Watch to see why I’m calling this market "On Sale" for the first time in years.
